gemma2-9b-it->gemma4-12b-it.what_changes: data and post-training; 9.2 B to 12.0 B; system text folded into the first user turn (Gemma 2) against a system turn and an empty thought channel (Gemma 4); sliding windows of 4,096 against 1,024 tokens (exceeded by 99% of inputs); eager against SDPA attention; transformers 4.51 to 5.23

mistral-7b-v0.3->ministral3-8b-it.what_changes: data and post-training; 7.3 B to 8.9 B; tokenizer (Ministral 3 splits 'Crafted' into 'C' + 'rafted'); system text in the last user turn and a space before the reply (Mistral 7B) against system text first and no space (Ministral 3); transformers 4.51 to 5.23

qwen3-8b->qwen3.5-9b.what_changes: data and post-training; 8.2 B to 9.4 B parameters (Qwen3.5-9B: 9.41 B in the architecture, 8.95 B in the language model; 9.65 B tensors stored, with multi-token-prediction heads); tokenizer; the same empty think block before the reply; Qwen3.5's linear-attention layers; transformers 4.51 to 5.23
